scope: Known uniform physical-volume 4D de Sitter; independent identical N=128 clouds; fixed M; h in [0,1/2]
primary_gate: At least twofold reduction against refined KL sufficient design budgets at every declared h; same at-least-95pct fixed-budget analytical coverage.
fresh_policy: Execute only after primary gate passes. No enlargement, reseeding, refitting, optional stopping or domain extension. No unadjusted intersection or selection of 95pct methods.
development: Published historical KL counts used only to inspect cloud variances and choose the research direction. Analytical geometry, whole-domain variance certificate and off-grid controls developed before freeze. Target budget calculations and fresh data first run after public freeze.
evidence: The analytical variance bound supplies coverage. Independent lens quadrature and full fresh replay are internal verification, not external review.
